mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_wallet ( wallet_id, merchant_id, available_amount, pending_settle_amount, withdrawable_amount, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{walletId}, #{merchantId}, #{availableAmount}, #{pendingSettleAmount}, #{withdrawableAmount}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT wallet_id, merchant_id, available_amount, pending_settle_amount, withdrawable_amount, version, created_at, updated_at FROM merchant_wallet WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM merchant_wallet_txn_log WHERE biz_key = #{bizKey}
